directions.reason: Hard UP is distinct from neutral and begins the clockwise loop.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Bone muzzle, jaw point, paired sockets, and neck are centered with no left/right yaw.
directions.vertical_evidence: The chin lifts, skull underside and both sockets face upward, and the crown recedes.
directions.coordinate_evidence: Centered skull axis above the fixed neck; symmetric pink sockets flank that axis.

directions.reason: First clockwise diagonal combines a slight right yaw with retained upward pitch.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Connected bone muzzle and jaw shift screen-right of the neck; right socket dominance begins.
directions.vertical_evidence: Raised chin and visible skull underside remain close to 000.
directions.coordinate_evidence: Jaw tip is right of the 000 centerline while the socket band remains high.

directions.reason: Mid up-right advances both yaw and pitch smoothly.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Muzzle, jaw, and forward socket sit farther screen-right of the connected neck than at 022.5.
directions.vertical_evidence: Chin remains raised and underside remains visible, less steeply than at 022.5.
directions.coordinate_evidence: Bone facial centroid is right of neck center and above the neutral socket height.

directions.reason: Near-right diagonal keeps a smaller but genuine upward component.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Right-facing nasal ridge, jaw projection, and dominant socket approach the 090 profile.
directions.vertical_evidence: Muzzle and socket band remain slightly elevated relative to the horizontal 090 pose.
directions.coordinate_evidence: Facial bone projects screen-right of the neck with its jaw endpoint still above the 090 endpoint.

directions.reason: Hard RIGHT is an unambiguous bone profile.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Nasal ridge and jaw project screen-right from the neck and the forward pink socket dominates.
directions.vertical_evidence: Muzzle is approximately level, without meaningful up/down pitch.
directions.coordinate_evidence: Jaw endpoint and socket center are maximally right of the connected neck axis.

directions.reason: The first lower-right cell preserves right yaw while beginning a visible downward pitch.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Bone muzzle, jaw, and active socket remain screen-right of the neck despite the crossing ivory lock.
directions.vertical_evidence: Brow and muzzle tip lower from 090 and more crown surface becomes visible.
directions.coordinate_evidence: Jaw endpoint is right of neck center and below its 090 position.

directions.reason: Mid down-right has clear bone-side yaw and stronger downward pitch.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Connected muzzle and jaw remain screen-right of neck; the visible socket is on the right-facing skull plane.
directions.vertical_evidence: Crown area expands while socket and jaw descend toward the chest.
directions.coordinate_evidence: Bone facial centroid is right of the neck axis and lower than at 112.5.

directions.reason: Near-down cell retains a small genuine right yaw before the centered DOWN cardinal.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Jaw seam, lower muzzle, and surviving socket remain subtly screen-right of connected neck center; hair-tip direction is disregarded.
directions.vertical_evidence: Top of skull dominates and the face points steeply toward the chest.
directions.coordinate_evidence: Low facial features are just right of the neck axis and converge toward centered 180.

directions.reason: Hard DOWN is centered and clearly distinct from both lower diagonals.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Skull cap and neck connection are centered without left/right jaw projection.
directions.vertical_evidence: Crown faces the viewer while muzzle, jaw, and sockets tuck toward the chest.
directions.coordinate_evidence: Crown apex and neck share a vertical centerline; facial features occupy their lowest centered placement.

directions.reason: First post-DOWN diagonal opens toward screen-left while remaining steeply pitched down.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Bone jaw seam, muzzle, and socket emerge screen-left of the connected neck.
directions.vertical_evidence: Large crown area and tucked muzzle preserve the near-down pitch.
directions.coordinate_evidence: Low facial centroid is just left of the neck axis and rises slightly from 180.

directions.reason: Mid down-left advances left yaw without quadrant reversal.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Connected muzzle and jaw project screen-left; the visible socket belongs to the left-facing skull plane.
directions.vertical_evidence: Socket and jaw remain lowered while crown surface stays broad.
directions.coordinate_evidence: Bone facial centroid is left of neck center and higher than 202.5 but below 270.

directions.reason: Near-left diagonal retains a smaller clear downward component.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Nasal ridge, jaw point, and dominant socket approach the screen-left 270 profile.
directions.vertical_evidence: Muzzle and socket band remain below the level left-facing cardinal.
directions.coordinate_evidence: Jaw endpoint is left of the neck axis and below its 270 endpoint.

directions.reason: Hard LEFT is an unambiguous opposing bone profile.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Nasal ridge and jaw project screen-left from the neck and the forward socket dominates.
directions.vertical_evidence: Muzzle is approximately level, without meaningful up/down pitch.
directions.coordinate_evidence: Jaw endpoint and socket center are maximally left of the connected neck axis.

directions.reason: First upper-left diagonal keeps left yaw and starts a visible chin lift.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Bone muzzle, jaw, and active socket remain screen-left of neck center.
directions.vertical_evidence: Jaw and socket band rise above their 270 placements and skull underside starts to show.
directions.coordinate_evidence: Jaw endpoint is left of neck center and above its 270 endpoint.

directions.reason: Mid up-left combines clear left yaw with stronger upward pitch.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Connected muzzle and jaw sit screen-left of neck, with the left-facing socket plane dominant.
directions.vertical_evidence: Raised chin and visible underside move toward the UP pose.
directions.coordinate_evidence: Bone facial centroid is left of neck center and higher than at 292.5.

directions.reason: Near-UP retains a small genuine left yaw and closes the clockwise loop cleanly.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Jaw point, muzzle seam, and socket remain subtly screen-left of connected neck center, independent of the ivory lock.
directions.vertical_evidence: Chin is steeply raised and both-socket/underside presentation approaches centered 000.
directions.coordinate_evidence: High facial features sit just left of the neck axis and converge toward centered 000.
